text.p: Motorola Inc's Advanced Microcontroller Division on Monday launched its TouCAN series of microcontroller products with integrated controller area network (CAN) capabilities.
The technology is used in automotive power-train control, anti-lock brake systems and diagnostics.

Samples of the 68376 microcontroller, a 32-bit microcontroller and the first of the series, are available immediately for a suggested retail price of $30.40 each. Production quantities will be available in the first quarter of 1997 at a suggested price of $27.16 each in 10,000-piece quantities.
Volvo is an early adopter of the 68376 microcontroller for use in future products, Motorola said.
